subject: Meltwater status: pipeline live, render latency is the open risk
body:
Hi both,

Status for the week. The capture-to-trained-model pipeline hit the May 15 milestone: 22 scenes fitted, all overnight runs on Cirrus completing inside the window. Quality is where the JAX release promised — we're matching the paper's PSNR on our internal captures within 0.2 dB.

The open risk is render latency for the demo. On 8xV100 we reproduce the ~2.65s per 800x800 frame from the release benchmarks, which is fine for a scripted flythrough but not for free viewpoint control. Options: (a) pre-render camera paths and ship a video-scrub demo, (b) drop to 400x400 live rendering, roughly 4x faster but visibly softer.

Leilani also found ingest choking on two glossy SKUs — view-dependent effects need more input views, so capture ops should plan ~120 photos for those insted of 80.

Recommend (a) for the June LRB dry run.

Katya
